Ready for review. Added services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_sse_backpressure.py and support/evidence/BFF-CONSOL-012-sse-backpressure.json. Coverage: slow consumer fills bounded subscriber queue maxsize=1000 without unbounded growth; newest events are dropped for the saturated subscriber; replay buffer remains deque(maxlen=500) and drops oldest; disconnect aclose removes subscriber within 1s; replay after valid cursor preserves per-aggregate sequence fields and missing cursor raises SSE_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE/resync policy.
